description: This file defines the StartupService class which models the <startup-service> XML element used in service configuration. It includes parsing logic for attributes like name, runtime-data-id, runtime-delay, and run-in-pool, and exposes getter methods for these properties.

classes.name: StartupService
classes.description: A thread-safe class representing the <startup-service> element in service configuration XML, encapsulating service runtime configuration attributes.

methods.name: StartupService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a StartupService instance by parsing attributes from an XML Element, validating required attributes, and setting default values for optional ones.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the startup service.

methods.name: getRuntimeDelay
methods.description: Returns the runtime delay in milliseconds before starting the service.
